author: HBO Max
description:
On Season 1, Episode 2 of the Stuart Fails to Save the Universe Official Podcast, Lauren Lapkus and director Kyle Newacheck join Felicia Day and Wil Wheaton to break down “Spoiler: Zach’s in This One” and its terrifyingly cheerful AI surveillance universe. Lauren reveals how Chuck Lorre personally recruited her just one week after she had her second child, while Kyle explains how the team turned shock collars, sentient technology, exploding drones, and a giant multiverse “blorb” into comedy.

Felicia and Wil bring their full fan perspective to this behind-the-scenes conversation about Denise’s evolution from The Big Bang Theory, the return of Penny and Zach, and the challenge of making every SFTSTU episode feel like a completely new television pilot.
